accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: Never forget: democracies can, and have, voted for measures which lead to their own destruction. The job of democratic leaders is to warn that easy or popular measures, which may end some immediate conflict, must be resisted if in the end they risk destroying democracy itself.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech to the Carlton Club

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: Socialists often start by distributing wealth. They forget it first has to be created.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech to Conservative Central Council

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: We are the people who, among other things, invented the computer, refrigerator, electric motor, stethoscope, rayon, steam turbine, stainless steel, the tank, television, penicillin, radar, jet engine, hovercraft, float glass and carbon fibres. Oh, and the best half of Concorde.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech to the Conservative Party Conference

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: Prosperity will not come by inventing more and more lavish public expenditure programmes. You do not grow richer by ordering another cheque-book from the Bank. No nation ever grew more prosperous by taxing its citizens beyond their capacity to pay.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech to the Conservative Party Conference

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: We must never give in to the oldest and least democratic trick of all - the coercion of many by the ruthless, manipulating few.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Second Carlton Lecture ('Why Democracy Will Last')

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: Over-taxation is transparently foolish. Most of us are willing to work for our families and neighbours but not for the Chancellor of the Exchequer. In a free country people will work hard if it pays them to do so. At present taxes are so high that for many it is not worthwhile.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Election Message

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: We want a society where people are free to make choices, to make mistakes, to be generous and compassionate. This is what we mean by a moral society; not a society where the state is responsible for everything, and no one is responsible for the state.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech to the Zurich Economic Society ("The New Renaissance")

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: When you stop a dictator there are always risks, but there are great risks in not stopping a dictator. My generation learnt that long ago.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: TV Interview for ITN

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: We will not take money in taxes from those who work hard and pay it out to those who don't. We are trying to roll back the tide of Socialism. We must get 'stuck in' and sort out our problems in our traditional British way instead of asking the Government to intervene every time.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech to Finchley Conservatives

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: There'll never be a perfectly balanced economy. There's no such thing as total security. No job, no business can be guaranteed for ever. No government can free the people from material worries. But government can make people poor. It can waste what people create. Or it can provide the conditions which favour those private efforts and endeavours that bring prosperity.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech to the Conservative Women's Conference

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: The problem with socialism is that you eventually run out of other people's money.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: TV Interview for Thames TV 'This Week'

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: You know, there's a vindictive streak to Socialism that seems to be indelible.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech to the International Free Enterprise dinner

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: Ronald Reagan carried the American people with him in his great endeavours because there was perfect sympathy between them. He and they loved America and what it stands for: freedom and opportunity for ordinary people.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Eulogy for Ronald Reagan

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: In our over-governed country, the creative majority have too little freedom & the tiny minority of wreckers have too much licence. The government I shall form next weekend will reverse this decisively. Help me free those who create wealth & to make the wreckers run for cover.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Article for the News of the World

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: When I was British Prime Minister I was not always popular. Reformers rarely are while reforms are going through, though if we struggle on we reap the rewards later.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech to the American Enterprise Institute ("Re-learning old lessons")

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: In a free society, people can give away as much as they want to and whenever they want to. They don't have to say, 'I will only give mine away, if I can compel you to give yours away too.'  If they believe in pooling their possessions with others, they're welcome to do so.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech to the Institute of SocioEconomic Studies ('Let Our Children Grow Tall')

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: The best reply to full-blooded Socialism is not milk and water Socialism, it is genuine Conservatism.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech to Conservative Party Conference ("Confrontation with reality")

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: Popular capitalism, which is the economic expression of liberty, is a far more attractive means for diffusing power in our society. Socialists cry "Power to the people" & raise the clenched fist as they say it. We all know what they mean - power over people, power to the State.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech to Conservative Central Council

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: In the last few years, British patriots have, once again, had cause, as John of Gaunt did, to feel ashamed of the way that the nation was being directed. We know that Britain has been in dire straits before, and that she has recovered. She will recover again.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech to the Conservative Political Centre Summer School ('The Renewal of Britain')

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: Safe Socialism? If it's safe, it's not Socialism. If it's Socialism, it's not safe. Signposts of Socialism point downhill to less freedom, less prosperity, more muddle, more failure. If we follow them to their destination, they will lead this nation into bankruptcy.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech to Conservative Central Council ("The Historic Choice")

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: Democratic nations must try to find ways to starve the terrorist and the hijacker of the oxygen of publicity on which they depend.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech to the American Bar Association

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: Let me give you my vision. A man's right to work as he will, to spend what he earns, to own property, to have the State as servant and not as master, these are the British inheritance. They are the essence of a free economy. And on that freedom all our other freedoms depend.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech to the Conservative Party Conference

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: The primary duty of government is to maintain the absolute sovereignty of the law, always, everywhere and against any institution, however powerful.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Article for the News of the World

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: Destroying freedoms we have cherished and defended down the centuries won't worry the far Left. They like everything about Eastern Europe [as it was in 1977] - except, alas, going to live there - because after all the living standards there are very low.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Conservative Party Conference

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: We must be alert to the dangers of over-regulation and creeping control, which any number of fashionable and politically correct agendas demand and which any variety of power-hungry politician will eagerly supply.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: First International Conservative Congress

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: Marxist jargon has been replaced by soothing language honed in focus groups. Donkey jackets have given way to Armani suits. Pioneering holidays in Socialist communes have yielded to trendy Tuscan villa-breaks. But the old Left wing rancour and prejudice burn bright within.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech to the International Free Enterprise Dinner

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: It is one of the great paradoxes of history that Socialism, which has done so much harm - was born of a great humanitarian urge - the desire to give people dignity and security. The trouble is that too much security removes a man's dignity by attenuating his freedom.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech in Korea ("The Principles of Thatcherism")

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: Socialism does not produce a classless society; on the contrary it produces the most stratified of all societies, divided into two classes: the powerful and the powerless; the party-bureaucratic elite and the manipulated masses.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech to Greater London Young Conservatives (Iain Macleod Memorial Lecture - 'Dimensions of Conservatism')

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: We in Britain have seen that every advance to Socialism reduces the individual, exalts the State, exacerbates our economic problems and drains away our wealth.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech to the Christian Democratic Union (CDU) Conference

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: We Conservatives hate unemployment.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech to Conservative Party Conference

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: Many of our troubles are due to the fact that our people turn to politicians for everything.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech to the Institute of SocioEconomic Studies, New York

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: Senator Pinochet is in truth on trial, not for anything contained in Judge Garzon's indictment, but for defeating communism.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech at a fringe rally during the Conservative Party Conference

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: Terrorism is a deadly threat to our way of life, and we will not be cowed by it. We will continue to resist it with all our power and to uphold the principles of democratic government.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech to the Conservative Party Conference

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: Everywhere there is a crisis of Socialism. Everywhere a confirmation that capitalism produces freedom and prosperity.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech to the Conservative Political Centre Summer School

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: The Labour Party itself may have changed many of its policies, but it hasn't changed its spots. You can tell this from the unpleasant noises it makes when anything like profits are mentioned.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Keith Joseph Memorial Lecture ("Liberty and Limited Government")

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: One only gets to the top rung of the ladder by steadily climbing up one at a time, and suddenly all sorts of powers, all sorts of abilities which you thought never belonged to you suddenly become within your own possibility and you think, Well, I'll have a go, too.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech receiving International Women's Forum Award

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: They haven't changed their Socialist spots. They've just changed their suits.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech to Conservative Candidates Conference

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: Never forget that the Marxist societies call themselves, and indeed are, the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics. Some of the aims of socialism, are the aims of a Marxist society, and they result in the subjugation of the rights of people to political theory.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech to Conservative Women's Conference

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: Britain must stop being the kind of country that drives success into exile. That's another reason for cutting taxes. High personal taxes squeeze out talent and hard work. When that happens we are all diminished. We should honour success in all fields; in science, in commerce, in the arts, in sport. We must encourage it and help people to profit from it. Why begrudge them? We can be proud of their success. It enriches the lives of all our people.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech to the Conservative Women's Conference

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: This is not a confrontation between left & right. I am trying to represent the deep feelings of many thousands of rank-and-file Tories in the country - and potential Conservative voters, too - who feel let down by our party and find themselves unrepresented in a political vacuum.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech in Finchley (Conservative Leadership Election)

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: Socialists say "Government aid". What they mean is "taxpayers' aid".
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech to Conservative Central Council ('The Historic Choice')

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: The longer Labour remains in Government, the more vulnerable this country will be.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech at Kensington Town Hall ('Britain Awake')

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: Most people should know by now that unless you pursue the policies of wealth creation, you will not in fact get the improvement of social services that you desire. Just because you speak softly & talk more about welfare and social services doesn't mean that you do more for them.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Article in Newsweek titled 'Don't Undo What I Have Done'

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: 364 economists who claimed that it was madness to think you could get economic growth by cutting government borrowing were proved wrong: I'm told they were never the same again.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech to the Keith Joseph Memorial Conference

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: To me the most significant lesson is: never appease an aggressor. If we do, he will only grow stronger and more confident, and to secure his ultimate defeat will require greater effort and greater sacrifice. The longer you put off the needed decision and action, the higher the price in blood which has to be paid.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech to the Aspen Institute ('Managing Conflict — The Role of International Intervention')

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: It was the radical Socialist writer and patriot, the late George Orwell, who described the left-wing intellectuals as men motivated primarily by hatred of their own country. Socialists who spoke most about brotherhood of man could not bear their fellow-Englishmen, he complained.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech in Edgbaston, Birmingham

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: Let me say this, if you want someone weak you don't want me, there are plenty of others to choose from.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Radio Interview for BBC Radio 2 Jimmy Young Programme

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: What has happened this winter could happen again next winter and so on and so on. What we face is a threat to our whole way of life. The case is now surely overwhelming, there will be no solution to our difficulties which does not include restriction on the power of the unions.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Conservative Party Political Broadcast

accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.quote_text: My friends, every generation has to fight anew the battle for liberty. In my generation, Nazism and then Communism were the enemy, and they very nearly prevailed. Then, as now, strong arms and stout hearts were called upon to sustain the struggle for truth and right.
accepted_and_lead_same_mtf_document.source_event: Speech to Atlantic Bridge

eligible_same_document_event_or_date_pri.quote_text: Many of our troubles are due to the fact that our people turn to politicians for everything.

eligible_same_document_event_or_date_pri.quote_text: Senator Pinochet is in truth on trial, not for anything contained in Judge Garzon's indictment, but for defeating communism.
eligible_same_document_event_or_date_pri.source_event: Speech at a fringe rally during the Conservative Party Conference

eligible_same_document_event_or_date_pri.quote_text: Terrorism is a deadly threat to our way of life, and we will not be cowed by it. We will continue to resist it with all our power and to uphold the principles of democratic government.
eligible_same_document_event_or_date_pri.source_event: Speech to the Conservative Party Conference

eligible_same_document_event_or_date_pri.quote_text: Everywhere there is a crisis of Socialism. Everywhere a confirmation that capitalism produces freedom and prosperity.
eligible_same_document_event_or_date_pri.source_event: Speech to the Conservative Political Centre Summer School

eligible_same_document_event_or_date_pri.quote_text: The Labour Party itself may have changed many of its policies, but it hasn't changed its spots. You can tell this from the unpleasant noises it makes when anything like profits are mentioned.
eligible_same_document_event_or_date_pri.source_event: Keith Joseph Memorial Lecture ("Liberty and Limited Government")

eligible_same_document_event_or_date_pri.quote_text: One only gets to the top rung of the ladder by steadily climbing up one at a time, and suddenly all sorts of powers, all sorts of abilities which you thought never belonged to you suddenly become within your own possibility and you think, Well, I'll have a go, too.
eligible_same_document_event_or_date_pri.source_event: Speech receiving International Women's Forum Award

eligible_same_document_event_or_date_pri.quote_text: They haven't changed their Socialist spots. They've just changed their suits.
eligible_same_document_event_or_date_pri.source_event: Speech to Conservative Candidates Conference

eligible_same_document_event_or_date_pri.quote_text: Britain must stop being the kind of country that drives success into exile. That's another reason for cutting taxes. High personal taxes squeeze out talent and hard work. When that happens we are all diminished. We should honour success in all fields; in science, in commerce, in the arts, in sport. We must encourage it and help people to profit from it. Why begrudge them? We can be proud of their success. It enriches the lives of all our people.
eligible_same_document_event_or_date_pri.source_event: Speech to the Conservative Women's Conference

eligible_same_document_event_or_date_pri.quote_text: This is not a confrontation between left & right. I am trying to represent the deep feelings of many thousands of rank-and-file Tories in the country - and potential Conservative voters, too - who feel let down by our party and find themselves unrepresented in a political vacuum.
eligible_same_document_event_or_date_pri.source_event: Speech in Finchley (Conservative Leadership Election)

eligible_same_document_event_or_date_pri.quote_text: Socialists say "Government aid". What they mean is "taxpayers' aid".
eligible_same_document_event_or_date_pri.source_event: Speech to Conservative Central Council ('The Historic Choice')

eligible_same_document_event_or_date_pri.quote_text: The longer Labour remains in Government, the more vulnerable this country will be.
eligible_same_document_event_or_date_pri.source_event: Speech at Kensington Town Hall ('Britain Awake')

eligible_same_document_event_or_date_pri.quote_text: Most people should know by now that unless you pursue the policies of wealth creation, you will not in fact get the improvement of social services that you desire. Just because you speak softly & talk more about welfare and social services doesn't mean that you do more for them.
eligible_same_document_event_or_date_pri.source_event: Article in Newsweek titled 'Don't Undo What I Have Done'

eligible_same_document_event_or_date_pri.quote_text: 364 economists who claimed that it was madness to think you could get economic growth by cutting government borrowing were proved wrong: I'm told they were never the same again.
eligible_same_document_event_or_date_pri.source_event: Speech to the Keith Joseph Memorial Conference

eligible_same_document_event_or_date_pri.quote_text: Let me say this, if you want someone weak you don't want me, there are plenty of others to choose from.
eligible_same_document_event_or_date_pri.source_event: Radio Interview for BBC Radio 2 Jimmy Young Programme

eligible_same_document_event_or_date_pri.quote_text: What has happened this winter could happen again next winter and so on and so on. What we face is a threat to our whole way of life. The case is now surely overwhelming, there will be no solution to our difficulties which does not include restriction on the power of the unions.
eligible_same_document_event_or_date_pri.source_event: Conservative Party Political Broadcast

eligible_same_document_event_or_date_pri.quote_text: My friends, every generation has to fight anew the battle for liberty. In my generation, Nazism and then Communism were the enemy, and they very nearly prevailed. Then, as now, strong arms and stout hearts were called upon to sustain the struggle for truth and right.
eligible_same_document_event_or_date_pri.source_event: Speech to Atlantic Bridge

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Attempts to suppress national differences or to amalgamate different nations with distinct traditions into artificial states are very likely to fail, perhaps bloodily. The wise statesman will celebrate nationhood - and use it.

surfaces.meaning: That artificial political unions ignoring distinct national identities are inherently unstable and prone to conflict, whereas acknowledging nationhood is a tool for effective governance.
That artificial political unions ignoring distinct national identities are inherently unstable and prone to conflict, whereas acknowledging nationhood is a tool for effective governance.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Great political economists, the greatest of them Adam Smith, have shown how a market economy, by devolving the power of consumer choice to customers, runs with the grain of democracy, which disperses the power of political choice to voters.

surfaces.meaning: A free market economy inherently supports and parallels democratic systems because both distribute power to the individual (as consumers and voters) rather than centralising it in the state.
A free market economy inherently supports and parallels democratic systems because both distribute power to the individual (as consumers and voters) rather than centralising it in the state.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: We must never forget that it is in fact capitalism which has the moral quality in society. Not socialism, which is the elevation of the power of the government over the people.

surfaces.meaning: Capitalism is inherently moral because it relies on voluntary cooperation and individual freedom, whereas socialism is coercive and subjugates citizens to the state.
Capitalism is inherently moral because it relies on voluntary cooperation and individual freedom, whereas socialism is coercive and subjugates citizens to the state.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: We know what works - the Anglo-Saxon model of liberty, property, law and capitalism. And we know where it works - everywhere it's actually applied.

surfaces.meaning: That the combination of liberty, property rights, rule of law, and capitalism is universally effective and should be confidently promoted worldwide without hesitation.
That the combination of liberty, property rights, rule of law, and capitalism is universally effective and should be confidently promoted worldwide without hesitation.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: I am interested in responsible trade unionism, responsible trade unionists prepared to build a prosperous industry, which comes from satisfying customers. And with a prosperous industry, we mean a fair deal for the people who work in it.

surfaces.meaning: Trade unions should focus on building prosperous industries by satisfying customers, which in turn guarantees a fair deal for workers.
Trade unions should focus on building prosperous industries by satisfying customers, which in turn guarantees a fair deal for workers.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Labour remains socialist, socialism is a creed which, by its very nature, is central control over the lives of people. Less freedom for people to use their own talents and abilities and make their own decisions, more power by government over people.

surfaces.meaning: Labour should not govern again because their socialist ideology inherently restricts individual freedom and expands state control.
Labour should not govern again because their socialist ideology inherently restricts individual freedom and expands state control.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Communism accounted for approaching a hundred million deaths. It enslaved the East, while its first cousin socialism impoverished much of the West. Nazism - that other brand of socialism - & its tamer forbear Fascism killed about 25 million. All have left scars on our societies.

surfaces.meaning: That all forms of collectivism and state control, whether left-wing or right-wing, are fundamentally related and inherently destructive to human liberty and prosperity.
That all forms of collectivism and state control, whether left-wing or right-wing, are fundamentally related and inherently destructive to human liberty and prosperity.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Everyone had something unique to offer in life and their responsibility was to develop those gifts - and heroes come from all backgrounds.

surfaces.meaning: To argue against egalitarianism that suppresses individual excellence, asserting instead that society benefits when individuals from any background are encouraged to maximize their unique abilities.
To argue against egalitarianism that suppresses individual excellence, asserting instead that society benefits when individuals from any background are encouraged to maximize their unique abilities.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: If you lead a country like Britain, a strong country, a country which has taken a lead in world affairs in good times and in bad, a country that is always reliable, then you have to have a touch of iron about you.

surfaces.meaning: That the nickname is a compliment rather than an insult, as leading a historically significant and reliable nation inherently requires unyielding strength.
That the nickname is a compliment rather than an insult, as leading a historically significant and reliable nation inherently requires unyielding strength.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: The truth is that Socialism is a system inherently inefficient, wasteful and unjust.

surfaces.meaning: That the economic failures of the past three years were not merely the result of poor administration, but proof that socialist ideology itself is fundamentally flawed and immoral.
That the economic failures of the past three years were not merely the result of poor administration, but proof that socialist ideology itself is fundamentally flawed and immoral.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Every step this Socialist Government takes to seize more power over our daily lives diminishes those lives and the freedom which is their essence and their strength. One of our principal and continuing priorities when we are returned to office will be to restore the freedoms which the Socialists have usurped.

surfaces.meaning: That increasing government control inherently reduces personal freedom, and that the Conservative Party's primary goal is to restore those lost liberties.
That increasing government control inherently reduces personal freedom, and that the Conservative Party's primary goal is to restore those lost liberties.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Our sovereignty does not come from Brussels - it is ours by right and by heritage.

surfaces.meaning: British sovereignty is inherent to the nation's history and constitution, meaning the UK delegates power to European institutions by choice, rather than receiving its authority from them.
British sovereignty is inherent to the nation's history and constitution, meaning the UK delegates power to European institutions by choice, rather than receiving its authority from them.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Time and again history beats out the same message. Competition is better for the consumer than State control.

surfaces.meaning: That historical evidence consistently proves free market competition serves consumers better than government control of industries.
That historical evidence consistently proves free market competition serves consumers better than government control of industries.
That historical evidence consistently proves free market competition serves consumers better than government control of industries.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Socialists ... believe in increasing the power of government, in reducing the choices left to the people, and hence in diminishing their liberties. Their methods are high taxation, regimentation, compulsion, closed shops and blacklists.

surfaces.meaning: Socialism inherently requires state coercion and the erosion of personal liberty to function. By centralising power and heavily taxing citizens, socialist governments strip individuals of their autonomy and moral agency.
Socialism inherently requires state coercion and the erosion of personal liberty to function.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Liberty is a plant of slow growth and one that demands constant and careful attention. Yet there seems to be an inevitability about it, for liberty is man's natural and desired condition.

surfaces.meaning: While establishing freedom requires time, effort, and vigilance, its ultimate triumph is assured because it aligns with fundamental human nature.
While establishing freedom requires time, effort, and vigilance, its ultimate triumph is assured because it aligns with fundamental human nature.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Socialism demands the concentration of power, and a drab uniformity throughout. Under Socialism all initiative, all authority, all resources, all wealth are eventually concentrated in the hands of Government.

surfaces.meaning: Socialism inherently centralises power and resources, destroying individual freedom and initiative.
Socialism inherently centralises power and resources, destroying individual freedom and initiative.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Labour accuse us of being divisive. I find this hypocritical coming from the party which actually believes, and practises, the theory of class warfare, the block vote, and the closed shop, and whose road to power lies in turning one section of the people against another.

surfaces.meaning: Thatcher argued that Labour's core policies and union ties inherently relied on conflict and division, making their accusations against the Conservatives hypocritical.
Thatcher argued that Labour's core policies and union ties inherently relied on conflict and division, making their accusations against the Conservatives hypocritical.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: You never compromise with violence. You never compromise with intimidation. You never compromise with those who want to use it to extinguish freedom and democracy, because if you do then the very things for which you stand are extinguished.

surfaces.meaning: Yielding to violence or intimidation destroys the foundational principles of freedom and democracy.
Yielding to violence or intimidation destroys the foundational principles of freedom and democracy.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: All collectivism is always conducive to oppression: it is only the victims who differ.

surfaces.meaning: That groups like the National Front are fundamentally collectivist, sharing the same tyrannical nature as socialism, and differing only in which specific groups they choose to target.
That groups like the National Front are fundamentally collectivist, sharing the same tyrannical nature as socialism, and differing only in which specific groups they choose to target.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: The distinctive mark of every Labour policy, from health to education, from privatised utilities to the labour market, is more government interference.

surfaces.meaning: To warn voters that a Labour government would inevitably lead to increased state control and interference across all sectors of society.
To warn voters that a Labour government would inevitably lead to increased state control and interference across all sectors of society.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Nazism and Communism - two truly cosmic evils, apparently in conflict, but in their similarity of doctrines and their baseness of appeal, mere mirror images of each other.

surfaces.meaning: That despite their apparent opposition, both ideologies were fundamentally similar in their oppressive doctrines and appeal to base human instincts.
That despite their apparent opposition, both ideologies were fundamentally similar in their oppressive doctrines and appeal to base human instincts.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Socialists say "equality". What they mean is "levelling down".

surfaces.meaning: Thatcher argues that socialist policies aimed at achieving equality do not elevate the poor but instead drag down the successful. She contends that this 'levelling down' destroys wealth and opportunity rather than creating it.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: I believe passionately that people have a right, by their own efforts, to benefit their families, so we have taken down taxation. It doesn't matter to me who you are or what your background is. If you want to use your own efforts to work harder - yes, I am with you all the way.

surfaces.meaning: Lowering taxes empowers individuals of all backgrounds to improve their families' lives through hard work, which is a fundamental right rather than a source of social conflict.
Lowering taxes empowers individuals of all backgrounds to improve their families' lives through hard work, which is a fundamental right rather than a source of social conflict.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: States, societies and economies, which allow the distinctive talents of individuals to flourish, themselves also flourish. Those which dwarf, crush, distort, manipulate or ignore them cannot progress.

surfaces.meaning: That societies only advance when they empower individuals rather than allowing the state to suppress or manage human creativity.
That societies only advance when they empower individuals rather than allowing the state to suppress or manage human creativity.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Socialism's results have ranged between the merely shabby and the truly catastrophic - poverty, strife, oppression and, on the killing fields of communism, the deaths this century of perhaps 100 million people.

surfaces.meaning: That socialism inherently leads to negative outcomes ranging from economic decline to mass death, and that conservative liberty is the necessary counter-doctrine.
That socialism inherently leads to negative outcomes ranging from economic decline to mass death, and that conservative liberty is the necessary counter-doctrine.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Of course it's the same old story. Truth usually is the same old story.

surfaces.meaning: Thatcher argued that fundamental economic realities do not change, dismissing a heckler's complaint that her arguments were repetitive by asserting that truth is inherently consistent.
Thatcher argued that fundamental economic realities do not change, dismissing a heckler's complaint that her arguments were repetitive by asserting that truth is inherently consistent.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Freedom and Socialism just don't mix.

surfaces.meaning: Thatcher argued that socialism inevitably requires state coercion to function, making it fundamentally incompatible with individual freedom. She sought to link the British Labour Party's policies to the failing communist systems of Eastern Europe.
Thatcher argued that socialism inevitably requires state coercion to function, making it fundamentally incompatible with individual freedom.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Socialists speak of a classless society. But their every action betrays their class consciousness. They talk of mass movements, block votes, class struggle, mass marches, mass this and mass that. People are not masses, or class members, but rather individuals and families.

surfaces.meaning: Socialism inherently relies on and perpetuates class divisions and collective identities, whereas Conservatism recognizes and empowers people as distinct individuals and families.
Socialism inherently relies on and perpetuates class divisions and collective identities, whereas Conservatism recognizes and empowers people as distinct individuals and families.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Christmas is a day of meaning and traditions, a special day spent in the warm circle of family and friends.

surfaces.meaning: Christmas is fundamentally about tradition and spending time with loved ones.
Christmas is fundamentally about tradition and spending time with loved ones.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Watch your thoughts, for they will become actions. Watch your actions, for they'll become... habits. Watch your habits for they will forge your character. Watch your character, for it will make your destiny.

surfaces.meaning: Individuals must carefully guard their inner thoughts because they inevitably shape their behavior, character, and life outcomes.
Individuals must carefully guard their inner thoughts because they inevitably shape their behavior, character, and life outcomes.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: The choice before our people is the historic choice; between state domination and personal freedom. Between suffocating, and breathing free.

surfaces.meaning: Socialism inherently leads to state domination and the stifling of individual potential, whereas Conservatism champions the necessary freedom for individuals to thrive.
Socialism inherently leads to state domination and the stifling of individual potential, whereas Conservatism champions the necessary freedom for individuals to thrive.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Labour's policies are a vote of no confidence in the ability of British people to manage their own affairs. We have that confidence. Confidence in freedom and confidence in enterprise. That is what divides Conservatives from socialists.

surfaces.meaning: Thatcher argued that socialism inherently distrusts the individual, whereas conservatism empowers citizens through free enterprise and personal responsibility.
Thatcher argued that socialism inherently distrusts the individual, whereas conservatism empowers citizens through free enterprise and personal responsibility.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Those of us who believed in the sanctity of the human spirit had no doubt that the communist system would eventually collapse, but it is remarkable that so many people, mostly intellectuals, were taken in by communism's lies.

surfaces.meaning: That communism's failure was inevitable due to its suppression of the human spirit, making it surprising that educated individuals supported it.
That communism's failure was inevitable due to its suppression of the human spirit, making it surprising that educated individuals supported it.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: With Socialism there are no half-measures; it's the full draught or nothing.

surfaces.meaning: Thatcher argued that socialist policies cannot be implemented moderately; they inevitably lead to complete state control and the erosion of individual freedom. She warned that accepting any degree of socialism puts the nation on a slippery slope to a fully state-dominated society.
Thatcher argued that socialist policies cannot be implemented moderately; they inevitably lead to complete state control and the erosion of individual freedom.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: What Britain needs is an iron lady.

surfaces.meaning: That defending fundamental Western values and freedoms against Soviet threats requires strength and resolve, making the 'Iron Lady' label a badge of honor.
That defending fundamental Western values and freedoms against Soviet threats requires strength and resolve, making the 'Iron Lady' label a badge of honor.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Quite simple: Do you give up the power to issue your own currency? Do you give up the pound sterling?

surfaces.meaning: The decision to adopt a single currency is not merely a technical economic issue but a fundamental constitutional surrender of national sovereignty.
The decision to adopt a single currency is not merely a technical economic issue but a fundamental constitutional surrender of national sovereignty.
The decision to adopt a single currency is not merely a technical economic issue but a fundamental constitutional surrender of national sovereignty.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Socialists don't like ordinary people choosing, for they might not choose Socialism.

surfaces.meaning: That socialist policies inherently rely on state coercion, because if individuals are given free choice regarding their wealth, homes, and schools, they will naturally reject socialism.
That socialist policies inherently rely on state coercion, because if individuals are given free choice regarding their wealth, homes, and schools, they will naturally reject socialism.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: You must have a government which believes very passionately in what it wants to do, is very strong in its sense of purpose and does not listen to siren voices.

surfaces.meaning: A successful government must maintain unwavering commitment to its core objectives and resist the temptation to compromise or yield to political opponents and populist distractions.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Once you give people the idea that all this can be done by the State, and that it is somehow second-best or even degrading to leave it to private people then you will begin to deprive human beings of one of the essential ingredients of humanity - personal moral responsibility.

surfaces.meaning: Delegating all social care to the state strips individuals of their moral duty to care for one another, thereby undermining a fundamental aspect of human morality and civic virtue.
Delegating all social care to the state strips individuals of their moral duty to care for one another, thereby undermining a fundamental aspect of human morality and civic virtue.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Socialism. We reject it utterly for, however well-intended, it leads in one direction only: to the erosion and finally the destruction of the democratic way of life.

surfaces.meaning: That state expansion and socialist policies inevitably destroy personal freedoms and democratic institutions, regardless of the humanitarian intentions behind them.
That state expansion and socialist policies inevitably destroy personal freedoms and democratic institutions, regardless of the humanitarian intentions behind them.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: A free society is inseparable from a free economy. It is impossible to have the first without the second. Yet Socialists do not believe in a free economy. They believe instead in state control. They believe, too, in the Government spending money before it has been earned.

surfaces.meaning: That socialist policies of state control and deficit spending inherently undermine the foundations of a free society.
That socialist policies of state control and deficit spending inherently undermine the foundations of a free society.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: State Socialism is not in the character of the British people. It has no place in our traditions. It has no hold on our hearts.

surfaces.meaning: That socialist ideology is fundamentally alien to British cultural values and traditions, and that the Conservative Party represents the true common ground of British politics.
That socialist ideology is fundamentally alien to British cultural values and traditions, and that the Conservative Party represents the true common ground of British politics.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: If you want something said, ask a man; if you want something done, ask a woman.

surfaces.meaning: Women should be entrusted with leadership roles because they are inherently practical and results-oriented, whereas men are often preoccupied with rhetoric.
Women should be entrusted with leadership roles because they are inherently practical and results-oriented, whereas men are often preoccupied with rhetoric.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Socialism and freedom cannot long co-exist in the same society.

surfaces.meaning: That socialism inherently requires the concentration of power in the state, which inevitably erodes individual liberties. Freedom demands the diffusion of power, whereas socialism demands its centralization.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Britain has a unique and proud record in history of safeguarding and advancing the rights of small nations and oppressed peoples. It was the Royal Navy which abolished the Slave Trade - the most altruistic use of force by a great power the world has seen.

surfaces.meaning: That military power is not inherently evil and can be used for noble purposes, making strong defence forces essential for protecting liberty.
That military power is not inherently evil and can be used for noble purposes, making strong defence forces essential for protecting liberty.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: There is much to be said for trying to improve some disadvantaged people's lot. There is nothing to be said for trying to create heaven on earth.

surfaces.meaning: While targeted, pragmatic assistance for the genuinely disadvantaged is a legitimate function of society, attempting to engineer a perfect, egalitarian utopia through state power is inherently dangerous and futile.

While targeted, pragmatic assistance for the genuinely disadvantaged is a legitimate function of society, attempting to engineer a perfect, egalitarian utopia through state power is inherently dangerous and futile.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: The Socialist myth is that governments can promise more & more, and take more & more, but that we can still keep our freedom. The truth is that if government does everything for you, it will take everything from you - first your money, then your dignity, & finally your freedom.

surfaces.meaning: That socialist promises of comprehensive government provision inevitably lead to the erosion of personal wealth, dignity, and ultimately, individual liberty.
That socialist promises of comprehensive government provision inevitably lead to the erosion of personal wealth, dignity, and ultimately, individual liberty.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Freedom is our most precious possession. To defend it and maintain it is no passive task, but one that requires continuous vigilance and resolve. Let it never be said that the dedication of those who love freedom is less than the determination of those who would destroy it.

surfaces.meaning: Freedom is not guaranteed by institutions alone but requires continuous, active defense and moral resolve from all citizens to withstand those who seek to destroy it.
Freedom is not guaranteed by institutions alone but requires continuous, active defense and moral resolve from all citizens to withstand those who seek to destroy it.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: When you stop selecting by ability you have to select according to some other inevitably less satisfactory criterion.

surfaces.meaning: Abolishing academic merit as the basis for educational selection does not eliminate selection itself; it merely replaces it with inferior metrics like geographical location or wealth.
Abolishing academic merit as the basis for educational selection does not eliminate selection itself; it merely replaces it with inferior metrics like geographical location or wealth.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Those eras in which a high value has been placed on the individual are the ones which have known the greatest advances.

surfaces.meaning: That prioritizing individual liberty and limiting state power is the only proven method for ensuring continual societal advancement and prosperity.
That prioritizing individual liberty and limiting state power is the only proven method for ensuring continual societal advancement and prosperity.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Nobody, not even the most hardened Labour apologist, can wish to see a repetition of the cruelty and callousness of this winter. None of us can be content with a society where such things happen without check or penalty. In that sense I am a reformer and I am offering a change.

surfaces.meaning: That the unchecked power of trade unions has led to unacceptable societal cruelty, necessitating fundamental conservative reforms to restore order.
That the unchecked power of trade unions has led to unacceptable societal cruelty, necessitating fundamental conservative reforms to restore order.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: What is more heartless than the all-powerful State? Do not the industrious and farsighted benefit the community as well as themselves?

surfaces.meaning: That a powerful, centralized state is inherently unfeeling, whereas individual ambition and entrepreneurship naturally generate broader societal benefits.
That a powerful, centralized state is inherently unfeeling, whereas individual ambition and entrepreneurship naturally generate broader societal benefits.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: No matter how hard they try, totalitarian countries can never extinguish the flame of freedom. Again and again, we see the evidence that if only the nations of Eastern Europe were allowed to choose, they would choose democracy and freedom.

surfaces.meaning: That communist and totalitarian systems are fundamentally unnatural and cannot permanently suppress the human yearning for democratic governance.
That communist and totalitarian systems are fundamentally unnatural and cannot permanently suppress the human yearning for democratic governance.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: I don't believe you can go on spending money you haven't got.

surfaces.meaning: Deficit spending is fundamentally unsustainable and inevitably leads to severe national economic crises.
Deficit spending is fundamentally unsustainable and inevitably leads to severe national economic crises.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Unlike some of my colleagues, I never ceased to believe that the level of unemployment was related to the extent of trade union power. The unions had priced many of their members out of jobs by demanding excessive wages for insufficient output, so making goods uncompetitive.

surfaces.meaning: Trade unions cause unemployment by forcing wages above market clearing levels, which makes domestic goods uncompetitive and destroys jobs.
Trade unions cause unemployment by forcing wages above market clearing levels, which makes domestic goods uncompetitive and destroys jobs.
Trade unions cause unemployment by forcing wages above market clearing levels, which makes domestic goods uncompetitive and destroys jobs.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: The old saying has it that the first victim of war is truth. But it is more accurate to say that the first victim of totalitarianism is truth. And truth is what Communists have always feared the most.

surfaces.meaning: Totalitarian regimes rely entirely on the suppression of truth to maintain power, making the free flow of information their greatest existential threat.
Totalitarian regimes rely entirely on the suppression of truth to maintain power, making the free flow of information their greatest existential threat.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: The Communist Party is like a monstrous parasite which consumes the flesh of its host and leaves behind a shell, which is designed to conceal the change by which the Party has itself become the State.

surfaces.meaning: The Communist Party is not a legitimate political entity but a totalitarian apparatus that fuses with and hollows out the state, meaning it must be completely uprooted rather than reformed.
The Communist Party is not a legitimate political entity but a totalitarian apparatus that fuses with and hollows out the state, meaning it must be completely uprooted rather than reformed.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Religion teaches us that every human being is unique & must play his part in working out his own salvation. So whereas socialists begin with society, and how people can be fitted in, we start with Man, whose social and economic relationships are just part of his wider existence.

surfaces.meaning: Conservatism is inherently superior because it respects the spiritual uniqueness and individual responsibility of human beings, whereas socialism treats people as mere components to be fitted into a collective societal structure.

Conservatism is inherently superior because it respects the spiritual uniqueness and individual responsibility of human beings, whereas socialism treats people as mere components to be fitted into a collective societal structure.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: Standing in the middle of the road is very dangerous; you get knocked down by the traffic from both sides.

surfaces.meaning: Political compromise and centrist policies are inherently weak and leave a politician vulnerable to attacks from all ideological factions.
Political compromise and centrist policies are inherently weak and leave a politician vulnerable to attacks from all ideological factions.

meaning_strengthening_indicators.quote_text: The Socialist myth is that government spending creates jobs. The truth is that the only permanent job creation scheme is a healthy economy.
